thread_text:
noah: quick flag - SDK 4.0.1-canary appears to change newline-escaping in the request body and a small portion of long-prompt traffic is failing parser on runtime 3.8.x. recommending a scoped runtime pin for the "long-prompt" cohort during the 22:15 UTC change window.

ivy: can you paste the failing log?

noah: log snippet:
```
2026-04-18T21:55:10Z ERROR request: parse failure at escaped_newline
model: llama3q-long-1.2
runtime: 3.8.2
sdk: 4.0.1-canary
```

caroline: triage shows only requests with >1500 tokens and embedded newlines hit the issue. ops-recommendation: scoped pin to runtime:3.8.0 for model-group:long-prompt.

noah: plan: at T-10m run: `deploybot pin add --id pb-7711 --runtime runtime:3.8.0 --scope "model-group:long-prompt" --duration 180m --meta "reason:SDK4.0.1-newline-escape"`. monitor parser-error-rate and p95 latency. rollback threshold: parser-error-rate >0.5% over 10m -> rollback.

deploybot: scheduled pb-7711 for 2026-04-18T22:15:00Z by noah.

deploybot: executed pb-7711 at 2026-04-18T22:15:04Z  runtime pinned runtime:3.8.0 to scope:model-group:long-prompt (pb-7711).

srebot: alert rule created: metric=longprompt-parser-error >0.3% over 5m -> page @oncall-eng-sre.

ivy: monitoring now; initial drop in errors after pin. holding 30m watch.

noah: update after 90m: stable; plan to lift at 01:15 UTC unless product asks to extend. I'll add relnote and customer note for Dedicated owners.

deploybot: removed pb-7711 at 2026-04-19T01:15:07Z  pin removed.

srebot: pb-7711 lifecycle recorded: created->active->removed. no pager events.

caroline: relnotes entry added: "Temporary runtime pin (3.8.0) scoped to long-prompt models to mitigate newline-escaping regression observed in SDK 4.0.1-canary; short-lived and isolated."

noah: closing thread. thanks :thumbsup:
